purpose: Executable repository controls for the three remaining final-audit delivery blocks. This contract does not convert repository tests into production evidence.

requires: natural-language request interpretation through a declared non-test model boundary
explicit scope confirmation for material requests
forbids: repository-only assurance as real capability proof

requires: durable single-primary lease with monotonic fencing
remote backup plus restore evidence carrying production assurance
zero unresolved material contradictions before graduation

graduation_rule: PRODUCTION_GRADUATED may be emitted only when all three blocks present externally attested evidence and the active service lease remains valid.
